destination.note: Put your own witness journal here: one issue in a repository you do not develop in, one comment per anchor digest. A gist also works if your token has the gist scope. The point is a timestamp this machine does not control.

note: EXAMPLE — replace with your own before signing. Generate a purpose-limited, passphrase-free key (ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/loop_anchor_ed25519 -N ''), publish its public half in configs/allowed_signers, and pick an external repository you do not own the history of. The key proves the anchor was written by its holder; the external comment gives the digest a timestamp this machine cannot rewrite.
